source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of October 15, 2026, there were 3,952,757,946 shares of the registrant's common stock outstanding.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as TSLA; no preferred stock is outstanding. The 10-Q cover count is used as stated. It includes the 423,743,904 shares of performance-based restricted stock granted to Elon Musk under the 2025 CEO Performance Award, which the 10-Q balance sheet counts among the 3,953 million shares issued and outstanding even though they are unearned and voted proportionately; the 2026 proxy excludes them when computing his ownership percentage.
